newsitem.title: USA: Nasdaq recovers early losses, closes at new high.
newsitem.headline: Nasdaq recovers early losses, closes at new high.

text.p: Nasdaq shares recovered after an early selloff triggered by unexpectedly strong December jobs data and reached a new record high at closing.
The Nasdaq Composite Index gained 5.81 points or 0.44 percent to hit a new record of 1332.01. This surpasses the previous record of 1327.73 set on January 7.
The Dow gained 78 points to close unofficially at a record 6704. The long bond shed 1-7/32 to yield 6.85 percent.
Blue chip technology stocks led the Nasdaq recovery, with Dell Computer Corp gaining 2-5/8 to 60, Microsoft Corp jumping 1-7/8 to 84-1/4 and Intel Corp rising 1-1/2 to 144-1/2.

"When the market is this volatile, any economic data can make an impression. But the the changes don't last long. Tech stocks have had some swings, but there's strong interest in big names," one trader said.
Shares of Macromedia Inc, however, crumbled 4-3/16 to 9-5/16 after it posted an unexpected third quarter loss and analysts downgraded the stock.
Amgen Inc and Regeneron Pharmaceuticals Inc also plunged late in the day after disappointing clinical trials for treatments of Lou Gehrig's disease.
